initial_understanding: Reads «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» and assumes a page for parents who sell, then the description about Erbil properties and offers leaves her unsure it helps compare two projects (E-SITE-04, E-SITE-01).
main_confusion: The provenance phrase «نوێترین سەرچاوەی پشکنراو» says a source was inspected without saying what or by whom, close to her unexplained-verified trigger (E-SITE-08).
trust_concern_observed: Three spellings of one project, «شاری ئیتاڵی 2», «شاری ئیتالی 2» and «ئیتالی ستی 2», look careless to a skeptical reader comparing projects (E-SITE-10).
frustration_point: With low patience, landing on «نیشاندەرەکانی بازاڕ بەم زووانە» at /market and a page titled 'map.investment' at /invest is enough to close the tab (E-SITE-14, E-SITE-15).
most_useful_feature: none for this persona: amenities, parks and school distances were not in any observed project text (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-22).
missing_information: Which projects are near Family Mall, nearby schools and parks, and what «نوێترین سەرچاوەی پشکنراو» actually checked; 14 of 64 project pages carry one line or nothing (E-SITE-22).
what_would_change_decision: A plain Kurdish note on every project explaining what was inspected and when, plus amenity distances she can show her parents.
simulated_reaction: «دەنووسێت سەرچاوە پشکنراوە، بەڵام کێ پشکنی و چی؟ ناوی پڕۆژەکەش بە سێ شێوە نووسراوە.» (It says the source was inspected, but who inspected what? The project name is even written three ways.)

initial_understanding: Through the /en homepage she reads 'The true value of your property' and 'Explore Erbil real estate, market indicators and property offers with Andaz.' as a place to check prices (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: English area pages name neighbourhoods by transliteration, e.g. 'kwrany nwe', so she cannot tell which page covers Gulan Park or Zanko (E-SITE-20).
trust_concern_observed: Developer names such as «لۆریەنت کۆنسترەکشن» were recorded on Kurdish project pages; whether English pages name them, or who verified any price, was not observed (E-SITE-08).
frustration_point: Trying to reach market indicators on an unstable connection and finding only the coming-soon heading «نیشاندەرەکانی بازاڕ بەم زووانە» (E-SITE-14); keyboard focus and map behaviour were not observable.
most_useful_feature: The valuation theme in the hero and the /pricing page «نرخاندنی ناوخۆیی» match her interest in real values (E-SITE-04, E-SITE-16), though its content is unobserved.
missing_information: Verified prices and rising-price areas (T09 not observable), developer credibility in English, and advisor usefulness (T10 not observable); no price exists in project data (E-SITE-08).
what_would_change_decision: Readable English area names and an English developer line with a dated price source on each project page.
simulated_reaction: I came for prices around Gulan Park, and the market page just says coming soon in a language I do not read. (gloss: coming-soon market page in Kurdish blocks her goal)

initial_understanding: The hero «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» speaks to her as an owner; the description adds «نیشاندەرەکانی بازاڕ و پێشنیارەکان», so she expects a place to price and advertise a flat (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: Whether «نرخاندنی ناوخۆیی» at /pricing is a tool for owners or something internal; the heading does not say and the page is noindex,nofollow (E-SITE-16).
trust_concern_observed: The companies page reads «کۆمپانیاکانی خانووبەرە بەم زووانە», and no contact, terms or privacy page exists at the usual paths (E-SITE-14, E-SITE-17), so she cannot see who handles listings.
frustration_point: No list-your-property entry appears in the sitemap or any observed heading, and tenant contact routes are unknown because zero phone numbers were found (E-SITE-02, E-SITE-16, E-SITE-08).

missing_information: Whether listing is free, who sees a listing, and how a tenant reaches her; the market page she wanted for rent levels is «نیشاندەرەکانی بازاڕ بەم زووانە» (E-SITE-14).
what_would_change_decision: A visible owner path on the homepage stating listing cost, audience and the contact mechanism tenants will use.
simulated_reaction: «دەمەوێت شوقەکەم بە ٥٠٠ دۆلار بدەم بە کرێ، بەڵام هیچ شوێنێک نییە بنووسم خانووم هەیە.» (I want to rent my flat for $500, but there is nowhere to say I have a property.)

initial_understanding: On /ar he reads «القيمة الحقيقية لعقارك» and «اكتشف عقارات أربيل ومؤشرات السوق ومعروضات العقارات مع أنداز.» and understands a property site with offers he can browse (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: The Arabic offers index /ar/offers has no heading at all, while /ar/offers/map is titled «عقارات للبيع والإيجار — Andaz»; which page lists rentals is unclear (E-SITE-07, E-SITE-20).
trust_concern_observed: Trusting by disposition, he is mainly unsettled by Arabic text errors like «علي شلرع 120 متر» and «تتكون المشروع» in project copy (E-SITE-10).
frustration_point: Needing a house this month and finding zero phone numbers across homepage, project pages and the 404 contact path (E-SITE-01, E-SITE-08, E-SITE-17); whether rentals require login was not observed.

missing_information: Rental listings for Kalak (Khabat) with yard and parking under $390 (T02 not observable); a Kalak area page is not among the recorded names (E-SITE-23).
what_would_change_decision: A rentals list reachable from the Arabic homepage with a phone or WhatsApp contact on each listing, no registration first.
simulated_reaction: «الموقع بالعربي موجود، لكن ما لقيت رقم تلفون ولا صفحة واضحة لبيوت الإيجار في كلك.» (Arabic version exists, but no phone number and no clear rentals page for Kalak.)

initial_understanding: «القيمة الحقيقية لعقارك» suggests valuation for owners, while the description promises «مؤشرات السوق», which is what a first-time investor wants; the two promises take effort to reconcile (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: The Arabic area page for Kurani Nwe is headed «کورانی نوی», a Kurdish name in Kurdish letters, so Arabic readers cannot tell which neighbourhood it is (E-SITE-20).
trust_concern_observed: Her trigger: no company name, address or legal page; /contact, /privacy and /terms return '404 · Andaz' and only info@ emails were found (E-SITE-17, E-SITE-03).
frustration_point: Wanting real transaction prices for Shorsh and finding no price text in any project description; whether rising-price data exists was not observable (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-22).
most_useful_feature: Project status wording in Arabic such as «يصفه أحدث مصدر تمت مراجعته بأنه مكتمل أو جاهز» tells her whether a unit is ready (E-SITE-20).
missing_information: Which Erbil areas are rising in price (T09 not observable), real paid prices versus asking prices, and who operates the platform.
what_would_change_decision: A dated, sourced price trend per area in Arabic and a legal identity page before she considers an $85,000 commitment.
simulated_reaction: «يقولون القيمة الحقيقية، بس ما في سعر واحد ولا اسم شركة. شلون أثق بموقع ما أعرف صاحبه؟» (They say true value, yet no price and no company name; how can I trust an unnamed owner?)

initial_understanding: Reads the homepage as a valuation-and-data product for owners rather than a brokerage: «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» plus a description of properties, indicators and offers (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: Where agents fit: «کۆمپانیاکانی خانووبەرە بەم زووانە» at /companies means no agency profiles yet, and no listing attribution appears in project metadata (E-SITE-14, E-SITE-08).
trust_concern_observed: As a specialist he reads 'map.investment' as the /invest title as unfinished work (E-SITE-15); Arabic and English project pages canonicalising to the Kurdish URL also looks careless (E-SITE-09).
frustration_point: Impatient and wanting prices fast, he meets the /offers index with an empty H1 and no price text in any project page (E-SITE-07, E-SITE-08).
most_useful_feature: Provenance line «نوێترین سەرچاوەی پشکنراو» and developer attribution such as «ماس گروپ هۆڵدینگ» show how facts are sourced (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-22).
missing_information: Agent profiles, listing attribution, and the «نەورۆز» area's project list; the /places and /map pages exist but their content was not observable (E-SITE-19, E-SITE-16).
what_would_change_decision: A live companies directory with agency profiles and a visible lister name on every offer.
simulated_reaction: «بۆ من وەک دەلال، کۆمپانیاکان 'بەم زووانە'یە و هیچ نرخێک نییە؛ کاتم نییە بۆ ئەمە.» (As a broker: companies are 'coming soon' and there are no prices anywhere; I have no time for this.)

initial_understanding: The Arabic hero «القيمة الحقيقية لعقارك» talks to owners, not renters; only the words «معروضات العقارات» in the description hint that rentals might exist (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: Register page headed 'Create your Andaz account' in English at the default path, while she reads only Arabic (E-SITE-12); /ar/register was not probed.
trust_concern_observed: No social profiles to check the operator on (E-SITE-03) and /contact, /terms, /privacy all 404 (E-SITE-17), which for a skeptical renter means nobody accountable.
frustration_point: Her trigger is met early: no company name or legal identity anywhere observed, only info@andaz.app and info@mulkwallet.com, the second a different brand (E-SITE-03).
most_useful_feature: The Arabic offers map heading «عقارات للبيع والإيجار — Andaz» at least names rent as a category (E-SITE-20).
missing_information: One-bedroom rentals under $360 in Daratu or Bnaslawa (T02 not observable), real asking rents, and whether an account is required to contact a lister (E-SITE-12).
what_would_change_decision: An Arabic registration page and a footer with the operator's legal name, address and a social channel she can check.
simulated_reaction: «صفحة التسجيل بالإنجليزي وما أعرف من وراء الموقع؛ ما راح أعطي رقمي لجهة مجهولة.» (Sign-up is in English and the operator is unknown; I will not give my number to strangers.)

initial_understanding: Short Kurdish headings suit his basic reading: «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» and «نیشاندەرەکانی بازاڕ» tell him values and market data live here (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: Status «ڕاگەیەنراو یان داهاتوو» for Erbil Hills gives no delivery date, and no page states floor, size-based price or fees (E-SITE-08).
trust_concern_observed: Named developers and «نوێترین سەرچاوەی پشکنراو» raise trust (E-SITE-08); missing contact and terms pages at /contact and /terms lower it (E-SITE-17).
frustration_point: Opening /market for rising areas and reading «نیشاندەرەکانی بازاڕ بەم زووانە», then /invest titled 'map.investment' (E-SITE-14, E-SITE-15); load behaviour on his variable 4G was not measured.

what_would_change_decision: Publish per-project price basis, delivery date and fees next to the existing unit and floor counts.
simulated_reaction: «ژمارەی یەکە و نهۆم هەیە، بەڵام نرخ و بەرواری ڕادەستکردن نییە؛ بۆ ٧٢٠ هەزار دۆلار ئەمە کەمە.» (Unit and floor counts exist, but no price or delivery date; for $720,000 this is too little.)

initial_understanding: Understands from «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» and the description that Andaz positions itself around valuation and market data, not as a listing marketplace for brokers (E-SITE-04).
main_confusion: The Italian project appears as «شاری ئیتاڵی 2», «شاری ئیتالی 2» and «ئیتالی ستی 2» on one page; he cannot tell which name clients will search (E-SITE-10).

most_useful_feature: Provenance phrasing «نوێترین سەرچاوەی پشکنراو» and developer names like «ڕامی هۆڵدینگ» give him facts to check against his own records (E-SITE-22).
missing_information: Listing cost, lead handling, what location data is stored, and how «كورانی عەنكاوە» relates to Ankawa; the companies page is «کۆمپانیاکانی خانووبەرە بەم زووانە» (E-SITE-23, E-SITE-14).
what_would_change_decision: A privacy policy in Kurdish stating what is stored, plus a broker page with listing fees and lead delivery.
simulated_reaction: «پێش ئەوەی موڵکی کڕیارانم دابنێم دەمەوێت بزانم چی هەڵدەگرن؛ لاپەڕەی تایبەتمەندی ٤٠٤ـە.» (Before I place my clients' properties I want to know what they store; the privacy page is a 404.)

initial_understanding: For a seller-and-buyer the hero «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» fits half his need; the description's «پێشنیارەکان» hints at offers for the other half (E-SITE-04, E-SITE-01).

frustration_point: Wanting prices immediately, he finds the /offers index without a heading and no price in project data (E-SITE-07, E-SITE-08); a sell-then-buy comparison (T04) was not observable.

missing_information: Current values for Havalan versus Pirmam Road asking prices; Pirmam Road itself is not among the recorded area names (E-SITE-23).
what_would_change_decision: Show indicative prices on the first project or area screen and publish a privacy statement about location data.
simulated_reaction: «نەخشەی نرخ و ٨١ گەڕەک باشە، بەڵام دەمەوێت یەکسەر نرخ ببینم نەک بگەڕێم.» (Price map and 81 neighbourhoods are good, but I want prices at once, not a search.)

initial_understanding: Two short Kurdish promises, «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» and a description about Erbil properties, indicators and offers, are readable with his reading-support needs and frame a data product (E-SITE-04).

missing_information: Dated listings, unit prices, available Shorsh new-block projects (T05) and where prices are rising (T09), none observable; «شۆرش» and «مامۆستایان 1» exist only as area pages (E-SITE-23).
what_would_change_decision: A visible last-updated date and price basis on each project page, in plain short Kurdish sentences.
simulated_reaction: «داتاکە ڕێکخراوە و سەرچاوە دەنووسێت، بەڵام بەرواری نوێکردنەوە نییە؛ لە ئەمریکاوە نازانم کۆنە یان نوێ.» (The data is structured and cites a source, but no update date; from America I cannot tell old from new.)

initial_understanding: «القيمة الحقيقية لعقارك» on /ar reads as an offer to value his studio, close to what a seller wants, though the description talks about discovering properties (E-SITE-04).

most_useful_feature: The valuation page «نرخاندنی ناوخۆیی» and hero promise speak to a seller (E-SITE-16, E-SITE-04), although what the page does was not observed.
missing_information: How to list a Shawes studio, listing cost, and a phone to call (T08 not observable); zero numbers were found on every scanned page (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-17).
what_would_change_decision: An Arabic sell-your-property page with the fee and a phone number, reachable without creating an account.
simulated_reaction: «أريد أعرض الاستوديو للبيع، بس صفحة الدخول إنجليزي وصفحة الاتصال تطلع 404. أترك.» (I want to list the studio, but sign-in is English and contact gives 404; I give up.)

frustration_point: Needing a house now with no phone number on any scanned page (E-SITE-08, E-SITE-17) and an English sign-in 'Welcome back' at the account step (E-SITE-12); text scaling was not observable.
most_useful_feature: Her area «بەختیاری» and «ئیسکان» exist as pages with real names in title and H1 (E-SITE-23), which screen readers can announce.

initial_understanding: The default site is Kurdish (lang=ckb) which suits him, but «بەهای ڕاستەقینەی خانووبەرەکەت» is about owners' value while he wants to buy; the description's «پێشنیارەکان» is his only cue (E-SITE-01, E-SITE-04).
